7.d: Mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, vurrud teravaks keeratud, seljas tume ülikond.

17.d: Esiplaanil väike lahesopp ja paremale merre ulatuv väike kivine neem kahe suure rändrahnuga. Nende vahel silmapiiril merel kahemastiline kuunar. Vasakul lendamas kaks kajakat.
17.de: In the foreground a small bay and, on the right, a small rocky headland reaching into the sea with two large boulders. Between them, on the horizon at sea, a two-masted schooner. On the left, two seagulls flying.

34.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Kõrge laup läheb üle juusteta lagipeaks, mis külgedelt ja tagant piiratud kõrvuni ulatuvate ühtlases joones kärbitud juustega. Nägu piirab kitsas põskhabe. Kehakatteks punase nöörkaunistusega mulgi vammus.
34.de: Chest portrait of an older man in three-quarter profile to the right. A high forehead merges into a hairless crown, bordered on the sides and back by evenly trimmed hair reaching to the ears. The face is bordered by a narrow side-whisker. Clothing consists of a Mulgi jacket with red cord trimming.

35.d: Esiplaanil vahutavaid laineid, mille harjad koondunud vesineitside ja vesiratsude kujudeks. Lainetest kerkib keskel järsk kaljutipp, laskuv kaldajärsakuna pildi parema ääreni. Kaljult alasti naine pikkade blondide juuste lehvides vette laskumas, kuhu on juba käest kukkunud lüüra. Paremal, kaldajärsakul, rühm munki tõrvikute valguses, krutsifikside ja viirukianumatega. Vanim neist tõstab Lorelei suunas risti. Paremal äärel üks munk laintesse vajunud, vesineitsi embuses.
35.de: In the foreground, foaming waves whose crests have gathered into the shapes of water nymphs and water-horses. From the waves rises in the middle a steep cliff peak, descending as a coastal cliff to the right edge of the picture. From the cliff, a naked woman with long blond hair fluttering is descending into the water, where a lyre has already fallen from her hand. On the right, on the cliff face, a group of monks in torchlight, with crucifixes and incense vessels. The oldest of them raises a cross towards Lorelei. At the right edge, one monk has sunk into the waves, in the embrace of a water nymph.

1997.dm: lehe kõrgus: 28.0 cm; lehe laius: 34.9 cm
1997.d: Esiplaanil jõgi, kivisild. Silla taga üksik hoone korstnata. Vasakul rukkipõld, kivitara ning mets.
1997.de: In the foreground a river, a stone bridge. Behind the bridge a single building without a chimney. On the left a rye field, a stone fence and a forest.

1998.dm: lehe kõrgus: 28.0 cm; lehe laius: 34.9 cm
1998.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, taamal kiviaiast piiratud põld, teerada paremale. Metsa taustal üksik maja. Vasakul all nurgas näha kustutatud maja jälgi.
1998.de: In the foreground a body of water, in the distance a field bordered by a stone wall, a path leading to the right. In the background forest with a single house. In the lower left corner traces of an erased house can be seen.

1999.dm: lehe kõrgus: 28.0 cm; lehe laius: 34.9 cm
1999.d: Esiplaanil kivist barjääriga sild, selle taga kergelt varjutatud põõsastik.
1999.de: In the foreground a bridge with a stone barrier, behind it a lightly shaded shrubbery.

2046.d: Taluõuel, vasakul, kaevul mees vett pumpamas, samas kõrval, joogiküna juures kaks lehma. Pildi paremas servas naisefiguur tema juures rüselevate lammastega. Taamal, lattaia taga taluhooned. Värvigammas valdavad pruunid toonid.
2046.de: In the farmyard, on the left, at the well a man pumping water, next to him, at the drinking trough two cows. On the right edge of the picture a female figure with sheep jostling around her. In the distance, behind a picket fence, farm buildings. Brown tones predominate in the colour range.

6552.d: Ristilöödu figuur T-kujulisel ristil, millel ülal keskel näha ebamäärane valge laik - nimetahvel. Teostus impressionistlikus laadis. Taust sinirohelistes toonides, risti ümbruses helerohekaks muutuvalt.
6552.de: The figure of the Crucified on a T-shaped cross, at the top centre of which an indistinct white patch is visible - the title plate. Executed in an impressionistic manner. The background in blue-green tones, turning light greenish around the cross.

6693.d: Pruunides toonides kompositsioon: vasakul nurgas üks istuv ja teine tema ees seisev (kaabudes ja pikkades kuubedes) talumees. Taamal vasakul hall kaev, millest vasakul tõrs ja jupike teivasaeda. Kaevu ääres istub pottmütsis naine ja tema juures, seljaga vaataja poole, seisab pruunis vammuses mees. Taamal visandlikult antud taluhooned. Ülal sinine pilvine taevas.
6693.de: A composition in brown tones: in the left corner, a peasant man sitting and another standing in front of him (both wearing hats and long coats). Beyond, on the left, a grey well, to the left of which is a trough and a piece of pole fence. By the well sits a woman in a bonnet-shaped hat, and next to her, with his back to the viewer, stands a man in a brown jerkin. Farm buildings are given sketchily in the background. Above, a blue cloudy sky.

6984.d: Heledajuukselise poisikese rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas tumehall kaherealine kinnise kaelusega kuub.
6984.de: Bust portrait of a fair-haired boy in three-quarter profile to the right. Wearing a dark grey double-breasted coat with a closed collar.

7022.d: Ees meresopp kividerühmaga paremal, ja kitsa kaldaribaga ees ja vasakul. Vasakul, kalda lähedal poolküljeli paat. Kaugemal, merre tungival maaninal linn (Tallinn).
7022.de: In front, a sea inlet with a group of rocks on the right, and a narrow strip of shore in front and on the left. On the left, near the shore, a boat seen sideways. Further away, a town (Tallinn) on a headland jutting into the sea.

7025.d: Esiplaanil kivine rannik, paremal lahesopp paljude purjekatega tagaplaanil. Taamal Tallinna panoraam Kadrioru poolt.
7025.de: In the foreground a rocky coast, on the right a bay inlet with many sailboats in the background. In the distance, a panorama of Tallinn from the Kadriorg side.

7181.d: Esiplaanil rand kividega, kaluripaatidega, võrkudega ja kaluri figuuriga, taamal meri.
7181.de: In the foreground a shore with stones, fishing boats, nets and a fisherman's figure, sea in the distance.

7232.d: Esiplaani kitsal kaldaribal naine lapsega paadi kõrval. Vasemal tormine meri, kalda ääres vahutavate lainetega. Paremal merre ulatuv palkidest paadisadam ankrus purjepaatidega, tagapool majad. Taevas tumedais pilveis.
7232.de: In the foreground on a narrow strip of shore a woman with a child beside a boat. On the left a stormy sea, with foaming waves along the shore. On the right a log-built boat harbour extending into the sea with anchored sailboats, houses further behind. Sky in dark clouds.

7233.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaldariba madalate põõsastega, sellest tagapool kõrgem kallas puudega. Paremal meri paljude kividega. Keskel purjekas. Madal horisont, õhtune valgustus.
7233.de: In the foreground at left a strip of shore with low bushes, behind it a higher bank with trees. At right the sea with many stones. In the centre a sailboat. Low horizon, evening lighting.

7493.d: Tumedajuukselise noore naise poolfiguur selgvaates. Pea täisprofiilis vasakule. Üle õlgade sügavalt selga paljastav karusnahaga servistatud punane rüü.
7493.de: Half-figure of a dark-haired young woman seen from the front. The head in full profile to the left. Over the shoulders a red robe trimmed with fur, deeply baring the back.

7494.d: Hallide juuste ja vurrudega vanema mehe rinnapilt en face. Seljas eest avatud karusnahkse kraega mantel.
7494.de: Bust portrait en face of an older man with grey hair and moustache. Wearing a coat open at the front with a fur collar.

7544.d: Lainetevahus ees keskel purjelaev nelja inimfiguuriga. Taustaks rohekashall taevas, vasemal kauge laeva kontuurid, paremal kolm lendavat lindu.
7544.de: In the middle of the foam of the waves in front, a sailing ship with four human figures. In the background a greyish-grey sky, on the left the contours of a distant ship, on the right three flying birds.

7553.d: Esiplaanil keskel kalapaat nelja kaluriga. Merel paremal kolm purjekat. Taamal Tallinna siluett.
7553.de: In the foreground, in the middle, a fishing boat with four fishermen. At sea on the right three sailboats. In the distance the silhouette of Tallinn.

7554.d: Vasakul rand, paremal meri. Rannal ja vees kivid. Rand lõpeb maali serva keskkohas kaljuseinaga. Ranna ääres üksik paat inimfiguuriga. Maali paremal serval keskel merel kaljurahn. Ees mere kohal lendavaid kajakaid. Taga veepinnal purjekaid ja laevade siluette. Taevas pilvine.
7554.de: On the left, the shore, on the right, the sea. Stones on the shore and in the water. The shore ends in the middle of the edge of the painting with a rock wall. By the shore, a lone boat with a human figure. On the right edge of the painting, in the middle of the sea, a rocky boulder. In front, seagulls flying over the sea. Further back on the water's surface, sailboats and silhouettes of ships. The sky is cloudy.

7555.d: Noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas must kleit, kaelas kuldkett.
7555.de: Chest-length portrait of a young woman in three-quarter profile facing right. Wearing a black dress, a gold chain around her neck.

7624.d: Kahel pool äärtel kõrged puud, mille vahelt viib tee kabelini. Paremal kellatorn, kabeli seinas suur värvilisest klaasist aken gooti teravkaarega. Paremal kabeli kõrval varemed. Tee kaetud kollaste langenud lehtedega.
7624.de: On both edges tall trees, between which a path leads to a chapel. On the right a bell tower, in the chapel wall a large stained-glass window with a Gothic pointed arch. On the right beside the chapel ruins. The path covered with fallen yellow leaves.

7637.d: Toolil istuva tumedajuukselise poisi põlvpilt, poolprofiilis paremale. Poisil seljas punane musta kaeluse ja varruka äärestusega, läikivate metallnööpidega kuub. Süles käte vahel apelsin.
7637.de: Knee-length portrait of a dark-haired boy sitting on a chair, in half-profile facing right. The boy is wearing a red coat with a black collar and sleeve trim, with shiny metal buttons. An orange held in his hands in his lap.

7638.d: Keskealise habemiku mehe rinnapilt, täisprofiilis paremale.
7638.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged bearded man, in full profile to the right.

7707.d: Esiplaanil taraga ümbritsetud muruplats üksikute vanade puudega, millede vahelt paistab mansartkorrusega ja kõrge eestrepiga suvila. Maja viilul pärjastatud nimi ja daatum: LYBERTY 1798. Vasemal majake, mille kõrvalt näha tükike merd Tallinna siluetiga. Taga paremal pargipuud.
7707.de: In the foreground, a fenced lawn with a few old trees, between which a summer house with a mansard storey and a tall front staircase can be seen. On the gable of the house, a wreathed name and date: LYBERTY 1798. On the left, a small house, beside which a piece of sea with the silhouette of Tallinn is visible. In the background on the right, park trees.

7793.d: Naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Peas pitstanu lillega, õlgadel valge rätik.
7793.de: Bust of a woman in half-profile to the left. On her head a lace bonnet with a flower, on her shoulders a white kerchief.

7826.d: Esiplaanil jäätunud tiik kolme uisutajaga. Tagapool, paremal ja vasemal, tiigi kaldail raagus tihnik. Taga keskel valgustatud akendega maja.
7826.de: In the foreground a frozen pond with three skaters. Behind, on the right and left, bare thickets on the pond's shores. In the back in the middle a house with lit windows.

7829.d: Ees promenaad. Vaatleja poolsel promenaadi ääristaval murul paremal kolm last, keskel kolm mängivat koera. Tagapool laudade ümber inimeste grupid. Taustaks lehtpuu mets (park).
7829.de: In front, a promenade. On the lawn bordering the promenade on the viewer's side, three children on the right, in the middle three playing dogs. Behind, groups of people around tables. In the background, a deciduous forest (park).

7840.d: Sügavalt otsmikul istuva pärlitikandiga peakattes noore neiu rinnapilt; õlad pöördega vasakule, pea paremale.
7840.de: Bust portrait of a young girl wearing a pearl-embroidered headdress sitting low on the forehead; shoulders turned to the left, head to the right.

7844.d: Rokokoo mööbliga sisustatud toa nurk. Parempoolses seinas kaks suurt akent. Esimese akna juures harfi kõrval seisva daami figuur.
7844.de: The corner of a room furnished with rococo furniture. In the right-hand wall two large windows. By the first window the figure of a lady standing next to a harp.

7919.d: Võsamaastikul sinetaval lumel puid peegeldav veelõik, tagafoonil üksikud hoonete siluetid, õhtuehas taevas.
7919.de: A stretch of water reflecting trees on bluish snow in a scrubland landscape, isolated silhouettes of buildings in the background, sky in evening glow.

7948.d: Esialal madal kivine rannariba, mis ümber vasakult sisse ulatuva lahesopi kulgevana näitab kaugemal ka taimestikku. Silmapiiril metsakontuur. Õhtuvalguses roosastuv taevas peegeldub vees, mille kohal kaks kajakat lennul.
7948.de: In the foreground a low, stony strip of shore, which, running around a bay indenting from the left, also shows vegetation further away. On the horizon the outline of a forest. In the evening light the sky, turning pink, is reflected in the water, above which two gulls are in flight.

8259.d: Ees, eest taha suunduva jõe kaldal (vasemal), üksik kuivanud raagus puu; pisut tagapool paat. Kaugemal väikene maja. Paremal oleval kaldal salkkond puid. Üle maastiku öine poolpilves taevas.
8259.de: In front, on the bank of a river running from front to back (on the left), a lone withered leafless tree; a little further back a boat. Further away a small house. On the right bank a group of trees. Over the landscape a night sky, partly cloudy.

8261.dm: lehe laius: 25.3 cm; lehe kõrgus: 35.4 cm
8261.d: Eest kerges kaares vasakule taha suunduv tee. Teed palistab kolletav kasemets.
8261.de: In front, a road curving slightly to the left leading into the background. The road is lined by a yellowing birch forest.

8320.d: Istuva mehe poolfiguur, pöördega paremale. Tumedad juuksed, habe ja vurrud. Vasak käsi paremal põlvel.
8320.de: Half-figure of a seated man, turned to the right. Dark hair, beard and moustache. Left hand on right knee.

8421.d: Keskealise mehe rinnaportree en face, habeme ja vurrudega. Kaelas valge krae, krae vahel kraenööp.
8421.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man en face, with beard and moustache. A white collar at the neck, with a collar stud between the collar.

8546.d: Ees vasakul, liivasel rannal, kolm viilkatusega onni. Paremal taga veekogu, horisondil mets.
8546.de: In front on the left, on a sandy beach, three gable-roofed huts. On the right behind, a body of water, forest on the horizon.

8588.d: Seisva noormehe täisakt. Parem kõverdatud käsi toetub postamendile, mis on kaetud punase riidega.
8588.de: Full nude figure of a standing young man. The right, bent arm rests on a pedestal covered with red cloth.

8611.d: Habeme ja vuntsidega keskealise mehe rinnaportree poolpöördes paremale. Tume pintsak, valge krae.
8611.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man with beard and moustache, in three-quarter view to the right. Dark jacket, white collar.

8769.d: Stseen turult. Esiplaanil talupoja vanker, hobune paremal. Vankrist paremal seisab kübaraga talumees põrsas kätel. Vankri taga kolm naist, üks päevavarjuga, teine lõua all seotud kübaraga, kolmas korv käevangus - põrsast vaatamas. Esiplaan varjus, tagaplaan valgustatud - seal heledad laubalaudade katted ja õrnsinine riba taevast.
8769.de: A scene from the market. In the foreground a peasant's cart, a horse on the right. To the right of the cart stands a peasant man in a hat holding a piglet in his arms. Behind the cart three women, one with a parasol, another with a hat tied under the chin, a third with a basket on her arm - looking at the piglet. The foreground is in shadow, the background is lit - there, pale gable-board roof coverings and a faint blue strip of sky.

8790.d: Esiplaanil grupp kätega žestikuleerivaid mehi hobust kauplemas, vasakpoolsed kaks vaataja suunas, parempoolne profiilis. Tagapoolt kaabuga talumehi, vasakpoolne ratsa. Esiplaan varjus, tagaplaan valgustatud, siin heledaid kaubalaudade katteid ja kolmnurkne osa õrnsinist taevast.
8790.de: In the foreground a group of men gesturing with their hands while trading a horse, the two on the left facing the viewer, the one on the right in profile. Behind them peasants in hats, the one on the left mounted. The foreground is in shadow, the background is lit, here light-coloured coverings of market stalls and a triangular patch of pale blue sky.

8928.d: Pikkade juuste, habeme ja vurrudega vanamehe poolportree 3/4 profiilis paremale. Seljas hall kuub. Kaelusest näha mustade-punaste põikitriipudega rõivas.
8928.de: Half-portrait of an old man with long hair, beard and moustache, in 3/4 profile to the right. Wearing a grey coat. Visible at the collar is a garment with black-red cross stripes.

8947.d: Naise figuur istukil asendis, ülakeha paljas, käed ees vasakul paralleelselt, pea tahapoole kallutatud, paljas vasak jalg ulatub diagonaalselt maali paremasse nurka. Tugeva tumeda lakikihi alt kumavad heledad ihutoonid; sinakas rüü ja punakas tuli taga paremal.
8947.de: A female figure in a seated position, upper body bare, arms in front, parallel on the left, head tilted backward, bare left leg extending diagonally into the right corner of the painting. Light flesh tones glimmer beneath a thick dark layer of varnish; a bluish robe and a reddish flame behind on the right.

9075.d: Noore, alasti naise enam - vähem väljamaalitud rinnapartii ja nagu kaitseks väljasirutatud vasak käsi harali sõrmedega. Ümber käsivarre heledad juuksed. Parem väljasirutatud käsivars näha kuni pildi vasakpoolsesse alumisse nurka ulatuva küünarnukini. Naise nägu visandatud kergete söejoontega. Lõuendi ülemisel poolel vaba krunt. Väljamaalitud osas antud tume taust.
9075.de: A young, naked woman's more or less painted-out breast area and, as if in defence, an outstretched left hand with spread fingers. Light hair around the arm. The outstretched right forearm is visible up to the elbow, which extends into the lower left corner of the picture. The woman's face is sketched with light charcoal lines. The upper half of the canvas is a bare ground. In the painted-out area a dark background is given.

9138.d: Pildi keskosas lamaskleb täidlane alasti naisefiguur külgvaates, ülakeha kõrgemal, vasak käsi toetab pead, pikad juuksed langevad seljale. Keha käsitletud varjude ja valgusega, pea sulab tumedusse, mis katab tihedalt pildi keskosa. Esiplaanil suured roosad õied, mis samuti varjus. Ülaosas lehestik, milles üksikud lehe suurelt välja joonistatud ja ka valguslaikudega esile toodud.
9138.de: In the centre of the picture reclines a full-bodied nude female figure in profile, upper body raised, left hand supporting the head, long hair falling onto her back. The body is rendered with shadow and light, the head merges into darkness, which densely covers the middle part of the picture. In the foreground large pink flowers, also in shadow. In the upper part foliage, in which individual leaves are drawn out on a large scale and also brought out with patches of light.

9191.d: Elusuuruses naise portree istuvas asendis, otsevaates, valges rikkalikult pitsidega ja volangidega kaunistatud, sügavalt dekolteeritud kleidis. Vasemas käes lehvik, kaelas pärlikee. Naisest paremal, laud valge lindiga seotud lilled, mille vahel lebab kass. Lindi paremale otsale tikitud 1887.
9191.de: Life-size portrait of a woman in a seated position, frontal view, in a white dress richly decorated with lace and flounces, deeply décolleté. In her left hand a fan, a pearl necklace at her neck. To the right of the woman, a table tied with a white ribbon holding flowers, among which a cat lies. Embroidered on the right end of the ribbon is 1887.

9328.d: Kõrge pilvise taeva all taluõu. Esiplaanil paremal palkidest sild, sellele läheneb kahehobuseregi, eit-taat peal. Neist paremal seisab naine lapsega, naisel komps käes. Tagaplaanil paremal lumise katusega taluhoone, vasakul suitseva korstnaga talumaja ots. Vasakul, roigasaia taga tuulik, silmapiiril lumine mets.
9328.de: A farmyard under a high cloudy sky. In the foreground on the right a log bridge, which a two-horse sledge with an old man and old woman on it is approaching. To their right stands a woman with a child, the woman holding a bundle. In the background on the right a farm building with a snowy roof, on the left the gable of a farmhouse with a smoking chimney. On the left, behind a pole fence, a windmill, a snowy forest on the horizon.

9447.d: Esiplaanil keskel kahe künka vahel, puudega kaetud nõgu. Paremal künkal kasvavad puud; vasakul kaks talumaja. Tagaplaanil soo taga linnakese panoraam. Taevas pilves.
9447.de: In the foreground, in the middle, between two hills, a hollow covered with trees. On the right hill trees growing; on the left two farmhouses. In the background, beyond the marsh, a panorama of a small town. The sky cloudy.

9462.d: Lapse rinnapilt poolpöördega vasakule. Peas kübar, seljas hele jakk tumeda kraega.
9462.de: Chest-portrait of a child, half-turned to the left. A hat on the head, a light-coloured jacket with a dark collar.

9463.dm: laius: 31.8 cm (aluspapi mõõt); kõrgus: 19.8 cm (lm.); kõrgus: 28.7 cm (aluspapi mõõt); laius: 20.5 cm (lm.)
9463.d: Keskel Pikk Hermann tsaaririigi trikolooriga lipumastis (poolvardas); ümber majad. Ees paremal müüriäärsel teel üksik naisfiguur. Vasemal majakatus, puuladvad; taga meri purjekatega.(eesti)
9463.de: In the centre Pikk Hermann with the tricolour flag of the tsarist empire on the flagpole (at half-mast); houses around it. In front on the right a solitary female figure on the road along the wall. On the left a roof of a house, treetops; behind, the sea with sailboats.

9549.d: Päikeseloojang peegelsileda pinnaga, ees ja horisondil sinakasrohelise, keskplaanil oranžika, tumeoranžika ja sinakasroheliste viirgudega vee kohal. Keskplaanil vasemal vaatajast kergelt vasemalt mööduv kahemastiline kuunar selle juures (vasakul) asuva aerupaadiga. Taeva keskosas läbi kogu kompositsiooni laiuses tume sinakashall rünkpilvede mass, mille alt keskel viirab loojuv päike.
9549.de: A sunset over a mirror-smooth surface of water, bluish-green in the foreground and on the horizon, with orange, dark orange and bluish-green streaks in the middle ground. In the middle ground on the left, slightly passing the viewer on the left, a two-masted schooner with a rowing boat beside it (on the left). In the central part of the sky, across the entire width of the composition, a dark bluish-grey mass of cumulus clouds, from beneath which, in the middle, the setting sun shines through.

9580.d: Ovaalis tumedate juuste ning täishabemega pruunisilmse noore mehe portree, poolpöördes paremale. Pilk suunatud üles, huuled veidi paokil. Seljas helepruun kuub ja avatud kaelusega särk. Foon ovaalis sinakashall, selle ümber pruun.
9580.de: Portrait in an oval of a brown-eyed young man with dark hair and a full beard, in half-turn to the right. Gaze directed upward, lips slightly parted. Wearing a light brown coat and an open-collared shirt. Background bluish-grey within the oval, brown around it.

9602.d: Esiplaanil madal kruusane kallas. Paremal pildi sügavusse suunduv tee, keskel rühm kõrgeid puid; vasakul kääruline jõgi.
9602.de: In the foreground a low gravelly bank. On the right a road leading into the depth of the picture, in the middle a group of tall trees; on the left a winding river.

9610.d: Eesti talumehe põlvportree - nägu kuivetunud, lühike hall lõuahabe, terane pilk paremale suunatud; peas pruunikas-karvane talvemüts; vasak käsi hoiab suu juures piipu; vöötatud tume vammus sulab tumedasse fooni. Käsi ja nägu valgustatud, heledaim laik tumedal maalil kitasa valge kaelarätt.
9610.de: Portrait bust of an Estonian peasant man - a gaunt face, short grey stubble beard, sharp gaze directed to the right; a brownish, furry winter cap on the head; the left hand holds a pipe near the mouth; a striped dark tunic blends into the dark background. The hand and face are lit, the brightest spot on the dark painting being the white neckerchief.

9634.d: Noore naise rinnafiguur poolpöördes paremale. Seljas tume kleit, rinnas kimp margareetaõisi.
9634.de: Bust figure of a young woman in half-turn to the right. Wearing a dark dress, a bunch of marguerite flowers on the chest.

9695.d: Alasti, pikkade, heledate lahtiste juustega noor naine kaljult vette lahkumas. Keha poolprofiilis vasemale. Pea pööratud paremale. Tema vastu sirutab mõlemad käed välja veekogust ilmuv vesineitsi. Paremal kaldajärsakul näha osaliselt nelja munka tõrvikute valguses, kelledest vasakul pool olev tõstab Lorelei suunas risti.
9695.de: A naked young woman with long, light, loose hair is leaving the water from a cliff. Her body is in half-profile facing left. Her head is turned to the right. A water nymph emerging from the water stretches both arms out towards her. On the right, on the steep bank, four monks are partly visible in torchlight, of whom the one on the left raises a cross towards Lorelei.

9771.d: Eest paremalt Z-kujuliselt heinamaade keskel taha keskele kulgev oja. Taga vasakul ja taamal paremal mets.
9771.de: In the foreground, a stream running in a Z-shape from the right through the middle of the meadows toward the back center. Behind, on the left and in the distance on the right, forest.

9776.dm: kõrgus: 52.0 cm (vm. ovaal); laius: 39.0 cm (vm. ovaal)
9776.d: Noore naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Peas sinine turban, mille alt ulatuvad välja paksud seljale langevad punased juuksed.
9776.de: Bust of a young woman in half-profile to the left. On the head a blue turban, from under which thick red hair falling onto the back emerges.

9782.d: Meri kaljurahnudega paremal. Keskel kaks purjelaeva. Taevas täiskuu.
9782.de: The sea with rocky boulders on the right. In the middle two sailing ships. Full moon in the sky.
